verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents bank-hosted OAuth connections, institution-level OAuth coverage, or a plan to retire legacy credential flows. The only authentication material covers mTLS for API callers and a 'TAuth' scheme, which are adjacent topics, not bank-side OAuth. Community comments about users sharing bank credentials suggest credential-based linking, and none show OAuth coverage.

support.subject: As a developer, connections to major institutions use bank-hosted OAuth rather than screen-scraped credentials — the platform documents its OAuth coverage and how legacy credential flows are being retired
